caption:
Made your handwriting font? Here's how to finish and use it ✍️

1️⃣ Check the preview, tap any character that looks wrong and rewrite it
2️⃣ Give it a name you'll recognise, like your name plus "Hand"
3️⃣ On a computer, open the .ttf file and choose Install

It then appears in Word, PowerPoint and other programs. Great for invitations, cards and labels.

Make yours at font.315tools.com. Link in bio 👆
